First Digital Group, the issuer behind FDUSD, agreed to merge with CSLM Digital Asset Acquisition Corp III
in a deal that values First Digital at $250M on a pre-money basis.
The deal would take First Digital public on Nasdaq, and the transaction is expected to close in H1 2027, subject to regulatory approvals.
FDUSD has recorded $4.7T+ in cumulative trading volume as of June 30, 2026, while First Digital generated about $87M in FY2025 revenue.
The company said the listing would provide access to public capital to expand Finance District, its on-chain ecosystem, while adding greater transparency for investors and partners.

title: First Digital eyes Nasdaq listing in $250M KOYN deal
